environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind Kong Gateway (OSS 3.4) with a custom request-validator plugin instance bound to the /api/v1/network/diagnostic route. The plugin enforces a JSON Schema (draft-07) on the request body with 'additionalProperties: false' and the 'target_host' field constrained by pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.-]{0,62}$' with maxLength 63. The 'check_type' field uses an enum constraint. Additionally, Kong's request-size-limiting plugin caps body at 256 bytes. The Kong plugin chain also includes a correlation-id plugin that overwrites the X-Request-Id header with a UUID4 before proxying, and a request-transformer plugin that strips all headers matching pattern 'x-forwarded-*' and replaces them with verified values from the gateway's own context. The gateway terminates TLS and re-signs requests with an internal mTLS cert; the FastAPI service rejects connections without valid client cert from the mesh CA.
